header.comment: This configuration file was automatically created by GParserBuilder

max_iteration.comment: The maximum allowed number of iterations

min_iteration.comment: The minimum allowed number of iterations

max_stall_iteration.comment: The maximum allowed number of iterations without improvement

termination_file.comment: The name of a file which, when modified after the start of an
optimization run, instructs Geneva to terminate optimitation.
This can be used to "touch a file" after the start of an optimization
run, which will lead to the termination of the run after the current iteration.

individual_update_stall_counter_threshol.comment: The number of iterations without improvement after which
individuals are asked to update their internal data structures
through the actOnStalls() function. A value of 0 disables this check

report_iteration.comment: The number of iterations after which a report should be issued

n_record_best_individuals.comment: Indicates how many "best" individuals should be recorded in each iteration

cp_interval.comment: The number of iterations after which a checkpoint should be written.
-1 means: Write a checkpoint file whenever an improvement was encountered

cp_directory.comment: The directory where checkpoint files should be stored.

cp_base_name.comment: The significant part of the checkpoint file name.

cp_overwrite.comment: When set to "true", old checkpoint files will not be kept

cp_ser_mode.comment: Determines whether check-pointing should be done in

threshold.comment: A threshold beyond which optimization is expected to stop
Note that in order to activate this threshold, you also need to

threshold_active.comment: Activates (1) or de-activates (0) the quality threshold

max_duration.comment: The maximum allowed time-frame for the optimization

min_duration.comment: The minimum required time-frame for the optimization

emit_termination_reason.comment: Triggers emission (1) or omission (0) of information about reasons for termination

size.comment: The total size of the population

parameter_options.comment: Specification of the parameters to be used in the parameter scan

scan_randomly.comment: Indicates whether scans of individual variables should be done randomly
